message: An awaited value is bound whole, by a `const` that declares one name: every target declares the awaited value as one binding.
help: Write `const value = await load(…);` at the top level of the component's body, and read what you need from `value` after it.

message: `await` here is inside other code, and an async setup awaits only as the whole value of a top-level `const`, which every target lowers its own way.
help: Write `const value = await load(…);` at the top level of the component's body, and read what you need from `value` after it.
